view: Downward and forward aerial panorama plus lake aerial, reviewed east/west lake arms and the south approach to the Xiang plaza junction.
registration: Topology matched by lake, library and two road junctions to OSM way 1076344082 v2. OSM centerline and shared WGS84 origin retained. Lamp stations are approximate road-relative placements, not photogrammetric coordinates. Lake southern/eastern and western arms now bounded by lakeside-environment.json; historical photo presence and relative roadside positions only.
occlusion: Canopy-hidden lamp bases remain estimated. Junction interiors are kept free of edge lines. See lakeside-environment.json for scope.
precision: Road width remains the existing 7 m highway-class estimate. Paint widths 0.10/0.12 m, dash/gap 3/3 m, pole height 6 m and fixture dimensions are visual estimates. No independent metric accuracy or current-condition claim. South approach edge offset 8.45 m is an estimate within the continuous two-line OSM envelope; it is not a measured lane width.
